intro: Explore, customize your figure and download the result. Everything works offline.
pointHint: Focus or hover over a point to inspect its value.
scientific: A chart does not establish physical equivalence. Check composition, parameters and pseudopotentials; converged does not mean reviewed.
plotOnly: Export only the points visible in the chart
privacy: No local path fields. Review tags before sharing: they may contain private information.
tableRegion: Results table; scroll horizontally if needed
empty: No results match these filters. Try All or clear the search.
footer: Original data, customizable appearance. No external services.
noPoints: No points for these axes and selection.
badRange: Y bounds must be finite and minimum must be below maximum.
barZero: Bars must include zero. Adjust the range or use points.
tooMany: More than 2000 points: filter or reduce selection. No silent sampling or dropping.
omitted: omitted: missing value, other unit or outside bounds
scope: Export uses selected records matching the filters.
truncated: Snapshot is limited. Use --limit (up to 10000) to load more database records.
mixed: Different or unknown compositions/methods: exploratory comparison; check details.
units: Each axis option uses one exact unit; others are omitted. No conversions are performed.
metadata: Source IDs and hashes in CSV/JSON
uncertaintyNote: Recorded uncertainties are preserved in CSV/JSON; this figure does not display error bars.
subset: This copy contains only the exported records. Open the original view to choose other records.
missingSelection: saved selection IDs are absent from this copy; check the original file.
stateCaution: You include unconverged or unknown states. Their energies are not converged references: check details before comparing.
stateFigure: × / ▱: convergence unconfirmed; energy not validated for comparison.
energyBars: Energy bars starting at zero can hide small differences; use points to inspect them.
